comment: Power-efficiency experiment schedule. Phases run in order; the phase clock only accumulates while the node is discharging on battery above battery_floor_pct. 'set' keys are pushed via /api/set at phase entry; on guard trip or abort the node is reverted to the captured baseline. End of schedule = revert to baseline and idle.

phases.name: baseline
phases.why: Control: current shipping config (cpu 160, tx -1, dump 300s). Establishes the reference discharge slope.

phases.name: cpu80
phases.why: REC-phase CPU at 80 MHz (v1.54-hardened path). Abort on any interrupt_wdt reboot.

phases.name: dump420
phases.why: Fewer radio windows/hr. Abort if ring margin erodes (dropped_frames climbs > drop_guard_frames).

phases.name: txpower85
phases.why: Slower-but-cooler dump windows: compare window length x slope vs 15 dBm to find min energy per dump.
